queries: Sam Altman GPT-5 overhyped August 2025 not AGI PhD launch expectations
Sam Altman GPT-5 February 2025 unified intelligence roadmap X
Sam Altman GPT-5 "not going to be AGI" August 2025

sources_considered.why: Contemporaneous Business Insider reporting reproduces Altman's explanation of why GPT-5 fell short of AGI.
Primary launch disclosure documents capability improvements and the limitations of its knowledge-work results.

evidence_items.locator: Roadmap update, paragraph beginning In both ChatGPT

receipt.public_excerpt: we will release GPT-5 as a system

evidence_items.explanation: This is a concrete product-integration commitment. The roadmap does not commit GPT-5 to achieving AGI, so failure to achieve AGI cannot alone establish failure of this promise.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has yet to crack AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: The report describes GPT-5's launch capabilities and records Altman's explanation that it lacked continuous learning after deployment. It supports the non-AGI clause; the briefing itself occurred the preceding day.

receipt.public_excerpt: our best performing model on an internal benchmark

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports improvements and expert-comparable or better results in roughly half the tested knowledge-work cases. This is relevant counterevidence to a sweeping failure characterization, but neither establishes AGI nor proves that all material promises were met.

unresolved_gaps: No complete comparison establishes which material GPT-5 commitments failed.
The retrieved records do not establish GPT-5 as Altman's primary leadership mission.
No agreed AGI test makes the phrase in no way literally exhaustive.
